focus: Geometry/construction fidelity, material/PBR plausibility, weathering causality and temporal LOD integrity for the camera-right apartment rainwater leader

evidence: The legacy RainGutter was generated as a long cylinder and the separate HD_DownpipeClamp_* detail was positioned independently rather than reconstructed from one wall/pipe installation interface.

The existing material-physicality pass already identified RainGutter as PVC-U and clamp hardware as galvanized, but the official native review packet did not explicitly apply that binding pass before downstream construction QA consumed the material assets.

A first implementation audit found an approximately 11 mm empty source-geometry gap between the newly proposed wall plate and its standoff arm; this would have preserved a floating-bracket risk despite adding more detail.

The first implementation also used capped solid cylinders for coupler sleeves, pipe bands and the receiver. Those parts are sleeves/restraints and should surround the pipe rather than intersect it as hidden solid caps.

A second implementation audit found the first annular-mesh quad winding pointed the outer sleeve normals inward. The final substantive commit reverses outer/inner/top/bottom winding explicitly and keeps source validation tied to deterministic annular mesh identity.

implementation.manufactureInstallationReasoning: Retain one continuous macro PVC-U pipe silhouette but reconstruct observable installation interfaces: hollow section-joint sleeves, hollow pipe bands, wall standoff arms, wall anchor plates/fastener heads, a roof-line return/collar and a hollow ground receiver. The pipe is held proud of the facade by explicit restraint rather than visually floating. Hardware materials remain physically separate from the dielectric pipe.
implementation.geometryVsMaterial: Outside diameter, hollow socket/band/receiver construction, wall stand-off, anchor plate, fastener, roof offset and receiver insertion are geometry. PVC extrusion/scuff scale, mild chalking, galvanized microstructure, water spotting and localized dirt films remain PBR/microdetail. Painted/baked highlights remain forbidden.

materialReasoning.pvc: MAT_AgedDownpipePVC: rough dielectric, metallic approximately 0, smoothness target 0.18, nominal dielectric F0 approximately 0.04, no emission; UV chalking and water/dirt response remain cause-based.
materialReasoning.galvanizedHardware: MAT_DarkGalvanizedSteel: metallic workflow 0.75-1.0, smoothness target 0.40 with broad rough-metal angular response; no painted white glints.

implementation.weatheringReasoning: Drain-runoff metadata follows the actual leader; wall-side recesses/coupler lower lips retain more grime, ferrous residue is localized to real metal restraint/fastener sources, and ground-splash intensity increases only near the receiver. No disaster/damage narrative is introduced.
implementation.lodReasoning: The macro RainGutter body remains outside DanchiHighDetail so it cannot disappear at accessory LOD transitions. Hollow joints/bands/standoffs/plates/collar/receiver are source LOD0 and retain construction forms through LOD1 according to existing classification; millimetre fasteners are LOD0-only; LOD2/3 preserve only the macro pipe silhouette. Existing Danchi four-level animated cross-fade remains mandatory and visible pop can be cleared only from sealed temporal evidence.
implementation.nativePacketChange: The official Complete Native 4K Review Packet now applies scene material physicality immediately after final scene preparation, then reconstructs/validates rainwater installation before reflection probes. Rainwater QA repeats after asynchronous reflection completion immediately before Camera.Render and again after still sealing before prepared-scene temporal capture.

implementationReadiness.reason: This run meaningfully reduces construction/material/LOD source risk but does not supply the missing Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile/runtime evidence that the existing readiness model withholds.

expectedVisualScoreImpact: Geometry & construction fidelity (20): replaces a visually detached pipe/hardware concept with explicit hollow joints, restrained stand-off, anchors, roof return and receiver insertion; no points until rendered.
Material/PBR physical plausibility (20): actual PVC-U and galvanized bindings are normalized before reflection/capture and the pipe remains dielectric while brackets remain rough metal.
Weathering/context causality (10): rain runoff, recess grime, ferrous-source residue and ground splash are tied to actual installation components rather than arbitrary dirt placement.
Lighting/shadows/reflections (15): physical stand-off and hollow interfaces can generate real contact/occlusion/grazing response once probes and 4K rendering run.

Temporal/LOD/aliasing stability (5): the macro pipe does not participate in accessory culling; small hardware reduces through the existing four-level cross-fade path, but visible-pop clearance still requires temporal pixels.
Critical defect risk: floating/interpenetrating hero geometry, impossible material response, missing construction metadata and visible LOD pop risk are reduced at source, not cleared.
